confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cuenca, Ecuador, a mid-sized Andean tourist city that uses USD. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain: they are set from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of bar prices is weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain, especially hotel_3star_2p. No live listings or booking pages were inspected, and no anchor is sourced from a web search. FX provenance: the 2026-10-15 value was taken from a search-result summary that attributes it to the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open that page directly, so verify the figure against rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to general price levels in mid-sized Ecuadorian and Andean tourist cities, with Cuenca's lower-cost local restaurant and budget accommodation tier as the reference point. No single named comparable city was checked against live data.
